How we verify

Each fee is stored with the official page it came from and the date it was read.

  1. We read the fee from an official source (a government or authority page).
  2. We fetch that URL and record its status, a content hash and the date.
  3. Only then does the entry become verified and appear in search results.
  4. After 90 days without a recheck, the entry degrades to stale and is removed from the index — an old number is worse than no number.

If a source is unreachable we say so and leave the entry unpublished. We would rather have fewer pages than a page that misleads someone about a fee.

Every fee on this site carries an official source and the date it was last checked. Nothing is published without proof.
